title: Ambiano Slushie Machine $149 @ ALDI
body:
Deal: Ambiano Slushie Machine $149 @ ALDI

[jv] How long does it take to make the slushies?
[QuickToThePointless] 5 drink presets: slushie, frappe, milkshake, pissed and smashed
[TheDukeOfNukem] Was in Spotlight the other day, had pallets worth of the Kitchen Couture equivalent for 159 by the door.
It's not crazy how big the fad was, it's crazy how quick it died out though. (profanity) would stab you on the street for one of these a year ago.
[kanu666] KMart has for $129 https://www.kmart.com.au/product/devanti-5-in-1-slushie-mach…
[jv] Joan H (Verified Buyer)
5/5 stars
We found this product didn’t live up to our expectations. The soft serve program was not efficient or even good. It kept stopping with the same error. It didn’t keep the required temperature at all. Overall. I wouldn’t recommend this.
[N B] Marketplace product, not directly from Kmart
